owner_hardware_statement.platform: Apple M5 / 24 GB unified memory / 1 TB storage
limitations: This is the owner's nominal pilot target recorded from the AP specification, not an observation from the machine.
Nominal memory is not available model memory, qualified headroom, peak residency, or permission for concurrent model loads.
Nominal storage is not measured free storage and does not authorize a download or installation.

measurement_rules: Collect on the named target host with an operator-visible local-only command; never copy the owner statement into observation fields.
Record every installed runtime name and exact observed version separately from model or backend compatibility claims.
Measure currently available memory and storage at collection time; do not derive either value from nominal capacity.
Measure qualified headroom only through the owning installed qualification at a pinned Studio, runtime, model, configuration and collector revision.
Keep sequential load/unload as the intended architecture; an inventory does not authorize activation or concurrent residency.
qualification_requirements: Bind observations to host, collector and configuration fingerprints without storing credentials or private account data.
Distinguish observed_unqualified from qualified; only the latter may carry qualified_headroom_bytes and a qualification record.
Preserve blocked, skipped, unavailable and stale outcomes rather than replacing them with nominal values.
Re-run after runtime, model, quantization, context, host, Studio revision or material free-resource changes.

decisions.question: Initial specialisation/audience/format and launch order
blocked_actions: Declare a website, video or guest-desktop pilot as the selected launch specialisation.
Finalize a launch audience, output format, pilot rubric or launch order.
Present a generic direction sample as owner selection or final creative acceptance.
safe_work: Build generic contracts, fictional fixtures and evaluation harnesses that do not assume a specialisation.
Research adapters without installation, activation, account access or output-quality claims.
Keep website-first as a suggestion rather than a selected launch decision.

decisions.question: Installed runtime versions, measured free memory/storage and qualified headroom; owner hardware is M5/24 GB/1 TB
blocked_actions: Claim installed runtime, model, browser, media or guest-desktop capacity on the owner host.
Download, load, benchmark or admit a model from nominal 24 GB memory or 1 TB storage.
Claim physical unload, free-resource headroom, performance or safe concurrent residency.
safe_work: Develop hardware-independent contracts and mocked tests using invented profiles.
Prepare the operator-run inventory and qualification recipe without probing this sandbox as the owner host.
Preserve sequential load/unload and deny unqualified installed execution.

decisions.question: Permitted external services/providers, data scopes and spending grants; external reasoning-model use requires a separate explicit policy decision
blocked_actions: Send data to, create an account with, or spend through a real external service.
Use a hosted reasoning model, including fallback, judging, evaluation or improvement.
Treat provider configuration, a catalog entry or a fictional grant as live consent.
safe_work: Use local mocks and fictional scoped policy examples with explicit deny paths.
Keep local inference as the AP default while preserving future explicitly granted non-inference service adapters.
Evaluate source, license, egress and cost metadata without signup or activation.

decisions.question: Folders/accounts/network/retention and operating grants
blocked_actions: Read or write a real folder, reuse a browser/account profile, or contact a real network destination for AP work.
Retain private source, browser, media or account data without a versioned scope and retention rule.
Publish, deliver, schedule or execute against an external account.
safe_work: Use disposable fictional paths, accounts and destinations under offline tests.
Represent versioned grants and prove missing scope denies access.
Develop confinement, revocation and retention contracts without opening real resources.

decisions.question: Promotion classes, thresholds and owner review policy
blocked_actions: Automatically promote a lesson, skill, adapter, model route, evaluator or authority change into persistent production use.
Invent quality thresholds, risk classes, canary limits or owner-review exemptions.
Treat a shadow candidate report as approval to mutate production state.
safe_work: Run shadow evaluations and produce candidate reports with no automatic promotion.
Document risk classes and review boundaries while keeping every automatic_promotion flag false.
Reuse existing evidence-backed lesson and transformation candidate paths without widening their authority.

decisions.question: Current lifecycle/sandbox qualification and activation
blocked_actions: Activate a dormant native lifecycle, sandbox, browser, media or guest-desktop execution backend.
Resume paused Test8 or claim installed isolation, physical load/unload or machine-wide exclusivity.
Fallback to host execution when an isolation or lifecycle qualification is absent, stale or blocked.
safe_work: Audit call paths and implement offline refusal, cancellation and uncertain-effect tests.
Coordinate with the owning runtime/LC program while preserving legacy defaults.
Keep activation false and record installed qualification as not run or blocked.

classes.description: Ephemeral evaluation output that may be inspected but is not promoted into persistent behavior.
A project-scoped evidence-backed lesson that changes future retrieval or prompting.
Executable code, tool, CLI, MCP or service adapter with side-effect and supply-chain implications.
A change to policy, evaluators, routing authority, runtime lifecycle or system-wide behavior.

notes: Decision readiness is not story authorization; the AP ledger remains the story authority.
The register and fixtures are offline planning evidence and are not consumed by app.py or studio.py.
Absent decisions, grants, measurements and qualification deny affected live actions without blocking unrelated offline work.
